notes: Ladder test sheet: three vertical rails (left x~127-141, middle x~260-283, right x~388-412), each broken by one or two series parts, joined by five horizontal rungs that each carry two 2-terminal devices. The 512 crop cuts the sheet top and bottom - ink runs to y=0 and y=511 on all three rails - so I-DC 7, V-DC 9, GND 13 (all above y=0) and GND 15, Resistor 16 (both below y=511) are not visible and their wiring was inferred from their bbox positions. Net map: 0 = the two ground nets, merged per the all-grounds-are-net-0 convention. (i) Middle rail above Capacitor 12: from its top plate (260,131) up past the crossing at (261,119) to y=0 and on to GND 13 (bbox x 232-283, centred x=258, i.e. straight above the rail) and to the top rung at y~-42 where I-DC 7 (bbox x 172-226) and V-DC 9 (bbox x 308-365) sit; the I-DC right terminal and the V-DC left terminal land on it. (ii) Below the frame: the middle rail continues past y=511 at x=283 (verified pixel by pixel), runs down and left through Resistor 16 (bbox x 199-256, y 531-560) and on to GND 15 (bbox x 74-126, y 521-589); the left end of R 16 is that ground wire. n1 = left rail above Capacitor 11: its top lead leaves the frame at (127,0) and reaches the left terminal of I-DC 7. n2 = left rail between the bottom plate of Capacitor 11 (124,45) and the top of Inductor 4 (130,234), tapped by the rung at y~124 (cathode of Diode 5) and the rung at y~213 (anode of Zener 17). n3 = left rail from the bottom of Inductor 4 (133,320) down to the corner at (141,508), tapped by the rung at y~351 (cathode of Diode 1) and ending in the bottom rung at y~506 (anode of Diode 3). n4 = middle rail between the bottom plate of Capacitor 12 (258,165) and the top of Inductor 8 (272,378): junction dot at (260,212) joining the cathode of Zener 17 and the cathode of Diode 2, and junction dot at (266,347) joining the anode of Diode 1 and the anode of Zener 10. n5 = middle rail from the bottom of Inductor 8 (280,468) down through the junction dot at (282,504) (cathode of Diode 3 on the left, cathode of Diode 6 on the right) and out of the bottom of the frame to the right terminal of R 16. n6 = right rail above Inductor 0 (bbox top y=-9.5), off-frame, reaching the right terminal of V-DC 9. n7 = right rail from the bottom of Inductor 0 (387,76) down to the top plate of Capacitor 14 (397,246), T-joined at (389,107) by the rung carrying component 18 and at (392,205) by the anode of Diode 2. n8 = right rail from the bottom plate of Capacitor 14 (396,288) down to the corner at (412,490), T-joined at (394,341) by the cathode of Zener 10 and ending in the bottom rung at the anode of Diode 6. n9 = the y~119 rung between the anode of Diode 5 (210,122) and the anode of component 18 (312,114); it crosses the middle rail at (261,119) WITHOUT connecting - see judgment call (a). Judgment calls: (a) The four places where a rung crosses the middle rail were compared pixel by pixel. At (260,212), (266,347) and (282,504) the ink is visibly blobbed - the 13x13 window holds 83, 70 and 75 ink pixels and the vertical widens to 4 px - i.e. drawn junction dots. At (261,119) there is a perfectly clean 2 px x 3 px cross, 58 ink pixels, no thickening at all and no hop arc. The drafter therefore dots the joints and leaves the one non-joint plain, so the y~119 rung is read as a CROSSING and Diode 5 + component 18 form their own net n9. This is the single most re-checkable call in this file; if it is wrong, n9 simply merges into 0. (b) Component 18 is annotated 'Op-Amp' but is unmistakably a 2-terminal diode: a triangle whose flat side carries ONE lead at (312,114), an apex at (350,112) and a cathode bar at x=352 with flags running up-left from the bar top and down-right from the bar bottom - the same Z-bar that Zener 17 and Zener 10 carry, and unlike plain Diodes 5/1/2/3/6 whose bars have no flags. There is no op-amp anywhere on the sheet and the symbol has no second input lead, so it was re-classed to Zener Diode and its terminal list reduced from 3 to 2. (c) I-DC 7, V-DC 9 and GND 13 are entirely above the crop (bbox y -67..-15, -73..-18 and -130..-85). Their horizontal placement is decisive: GND 13 is centred at x=258 against a middle rail at x=260; I-DC 7 is centred at x=199 against the midpoint (194) of the left and middle rails; V-DC 9 is centred at x=337 against the midpoint (326) of the middle and right rails. They are therefore read as a top rung left-rail - I-DC 7 - middle-rail - V-DC 9 - right-rail with GND 13 hanging off the middle rail above it. Source polarity/arrow direction cannot be seen, so terminals are simply indexed left-then-right. (d) The left rail does NOT continue below the frame: at 20x its bottom is a clean L corner at (141,508) turning right into the bottom rung, and rows 509-511 hold only the corner blob. The middle rail does continue (ink at x=283 on rows 510 and 511). So GND 15 and R 16 hang off the middle rail's lower continuation, not off the left rail. (e) Diode/zener sides as drawn (bar = cathode): Diode 5 cathode left; component 18 cathode right; Zener 17 cathode right; Diode 2 cathode left; Diode 1 cathode left; Zener 10 cathode right; Diode 3 cathode right; Diode 6 cathode left. Terminals are indexed positionally (left-then-right for the rung parts and R 16, top-then-bottom for the parts inside the vertical rails), which does not affect any metric. (f) The rungs T cleanly into the left and right rails (the rung ink stops at the rail there), so those contacts are unambiguous junctions.
